channel.title: Boulder City Review - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Boulder City Review (bouldercityreview.com)

item.title: Celebrating America’s 250th anniversary with love
item.description: Every family likely celebrates love in a different manner during the holiday season, don’t they? Isn’t it likely that in this 250th year of our nation’s independence from Great Britain, America would celebrate love in a unique manner?

item.title: Lady Eagles move up in standings
item.description: Winning a pair of league games this past week, Boulder City High School girls basketball jumped up to third place in the 3A league standings.

item.title: Flag football evens record with wins
item.description: Winning a pair of games this past week, Boulder City High School flag football advanced to 6-6 on the season.

item.title: Former Boulder City High School football coach arrested, faces 10 felony counts
item.description: Frank “Bubba” Mariani did not coach the Eagles’ playoff loss to end last season. A criminal investigation ensued, and he is no longer allowed on campus.

item.title: Former 7-11 building for sale, again
item.description: The location had been set to be a Pinkbox Doughnuts.

item.title: BC’s Manteris authors tell-all industry book
item.description: Art Manteris, former Las Vegas Hilton and Station Casinos sportsbook vice president, recently released a new book, “The Bookie: How I Bet It All on Sports Gambling and Watched an Industry Explode.”

item.title: Commission looks at filtration plant’s future
item.description: It’s been around for 95 years and to ensure it does not fall into disrepair, the city is deciding what to do with it.

item.title: Defense leads way on gridiron
item.description: Boulder City High School flag football advanced to 7-7 on the season after splitting a pair of games this past week.

item.title: Eagles split a pair of games this week
item.description: Splitting a pair of league games this past week, Boulder City High School boys basketball sits in third place in the 3A league standings.

item.title: Lady Eagles drop a pair on the court
item.description: Currently sitting in fourth place in the 3A standings, Boulder City High School girls basketball dropped a pair of games this past week to Coral Academy and rival Virgin Valley.
